content.title: Floating Companion Orbit | Stable Hero, Shoulder Pass and Palm-Side Rest
content.summary: A small echo creature orbits an adult sound scout and receives restrained responses. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult character and all identity anchors persist. + One companion follows a complete traceable orbit. + The companion never merges with the body or clothing. + Character reactions remain small and temporally follow proximity. + The terminal full-body frame restores the opening spatial balance.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult animated sound scout with rose hair, round headphones, a teal jacket and a square field pack. Orbit the creature across the chest toward the right forearm while the scout keeps both feet planted. Send the creature behind the right shoulder and restore the opening full-body frame with one soft smile.
required_anchors: One clearly adult character and all identity anchors persist.
One companion follows a complete traceable orbit.
Character reactions remain small and temporally follow proximity.
The terminal full-body frame restores the opening spatial balance.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A small echo creature orbits an adult sound scout and receives restrained responses. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定同一成年动漫人物、粉发耳机、青色外套和白色棚景，让黑色青尾伙伴从肩后出现、绕过胸前和手臂、贴近脸侧，再回到人物身后；人物只用眼神、眨眼和小幅手势回应。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult character and all identity anchors persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult character and all identity anchors persist."

invariants.rule: One companion follows a complete traceable orbit.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One companion follows a complete traceable orbit."

invariants.rule: The companion never merges with the body or clothing.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The companion never merges with the body or clothing."

invariants.rule: Character reactions remain small and temporally follow proximity.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Character reactions remain small and temporally follow proximity."

invariants.rule: The terminal full-body frame restores the opening spatial balance.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal full-body frame restores the opening spatial balance."
